children: IonQ announced updated full-year 2026 revenue guidance of $450 million to $460 million following the July 31 SkyWater acquisition.
Updated 2026 revenue outlook: $450M–$460M, reflecting SkyWater contributions from July 31–Dec 31, 2026.
Guidance excludes estimated intercompany revenues under prior commercial agreement with SkyWater.
Company cites combined market traction and SkyWater manufacturing scale as drivers of strengthened outlook.
IonQ is hosting an Investor Day webcast Sept. 8 with an archive available for one year.
